name: business-wrap-ours
description: The default Business-Wrap look: warm paper, deep primary for structure, an accent kept for rules and marks, hairline tables, serif throughout.

layout.page: A4 portrait; one A4 landscape sheet only for a wide workflow figure
layout.cover: full-bleed cover page with a primary-deep spine on the start side, title in display black
layout.chapters: chapter heading in primary on a primary heading rule; section numbers in accent
layout.tables: no fill band: bold primary header text over a 1.2pt primary rule, body rows on hairlines
layout.stories: story cards on the card ground, id in accent
layout.status: every coloured status is also worded (icon + word), never colour alone
